title: 第3章 望气术第4章 金石医药之书
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: “原来望气术竟然还有这么多讲究啊，山川形胜、宾朋高客都会影响一个人的时运”
【《云气占候录》解析中，预计解析成果望气术】
沉浸在书籍中的李叶青突然被耳边的声音惊醒，随即下意识地看向躺椅上的赵公公，后者已经消失不见，连带着那把躺椅一起。
抬起头看向天边，这才意识到竟然已经是黄昏了，一缕金光透过老树峥嵘的枝条投射到他手中的书页上。
老太监不在，刚刚那一句话应该不是他说的。
那就是说
他随即低头看向手中的《云气占候录》，只是一眼，书中看过的内容竟然浮现在脑海之中。
其中已经理解的地方犹如明星般闪耀，而不理解的地方就则是昏暗不明、十分艰涩。
“我的系统来了？我靠，我就知道老天不会让我这么惨的！有这解析系统在手，何愁不能恢复完整，享受人生！”
“哈哈哈哈”
“小青子，笑什么呢？快要入夜了，还不赶紧把书收起来！”
李叶青这才想起自己的职责，着急忙慌地将书收起来放回书架。
这一夜，连梦都是甜的。
第二天早上，外面下起淅淅沥沥的小雨，李叶青发现自己房间的一角漏水了，随即告诉了赵公公。
后者将躺椅放在门廊下，躺在上面打着哈欠。
“漏了你就拿个水盆接着，等到天晴了自己爬上去补一下就是，至于内官监的那群家伙你就不要指望了，他们能拖到你人没了。”
说到这里，赵公公突然看着他笑了起来，露出寥寥的几颗牙齿。
“五年前我就报上去了，那群家伙还是说忙不过来，在忙着给皇爷修大殿呢。”
对此，李叶青只能表示无语，无奈地走进书阁，拿起书架上的那一本《云气占候录》继续仔细地读起来。
就好像是一个渴望汲取知识的学生。
可惜前世上学的时候没有这种劲头，最后只考上一个大专，好在学校足够努力，毕业的时候愣是升级成了二本
【《云气占候录》解析完成，望气术v1（3200）】
又是一声提示音响起，对于此刻的李叶青来说如同世间最优美的音乐。
闭上眼睛静静回想，《云气占候录》中的点点滴滴浮现在脑海之中，就好像这本书是他所书写的一样，熟悉无比，而其中凝聚的望气术也浮现在心头。
李叶青心思一动，目光投向窗外雨帘之后的屋檐下，那个躺在屋檐下的衰老身影
“白色之气，代表着只是普通人，泛着灰色的衰败之意，这是行将就木之人的象征，这望气术果然神奇，不是作假。”
“这以后我岂不是可以随意抱大腿了？”
“不对，我抱什么大腿啊，这解析书籍获得技能的系统才是我真正的大腿，而这书阁对我来说就是一座无穷无尽的宝库啊！
我一定不会离开书阁，打死我都不会离开！”
“亏我当时还觉得来书阁有些不情愿，这简直是太香了！”
强行按下心头的激动，李叶青将手中的《云气占候录》放回书架上，随即又拿起另一本《形胜星象图集》，继续盘腿坐下看了起来。
五天之后，大乾庆顺九年四月初九、晴。
“御膳房的伙食确实是好，我看你这才去几天，就感觉整个人圆润了一圈啊。”
李叶青品尝着周刘培带来的食盒中的点心，笑着说道。
随即又拿起一块桂花糕放入嘴中，觉得有些干，又喝了一杯茶水。
周刘培闻言，下意识地摸了一把自己的脸，嘿嘿笑道。
content_en:
"It turns out that there are so many things to pay attention to in the art of fortune-telling. The mountains, rivers, shapes, guests, and guests all affect a person's fortune."
[In the analysis of "Yun Qi Zhan Hui Lu", it is expected that the result of the analysis will be qi gazing technique]
Li Yeqing, who was immersed in books, was suddenly awakened by the sound in his ears, and then subconsciously looked at Eunuch Zhao on the recliner. The latter had disappeared, along with the recliner.
He raised his head and looked at the horizon, only to realize that it was already dusk. A ray of golden light shone through the majestic branches of the old tree onto the book page in his hand.
The old eunuch is not here, so the words just now should not have been said by him.
that is to say
He then lowered his head and looked at the "Yun Qi Zhan Hui Lu" in his hand. With just one glance, the contents he had read in the book suddenly appeared in his mind.
The parts that are understood shine like stars, while the parts that are not understood are dim and very difficult.
"Is my system here? Damn it, I knew God wouldn't let me be in such a miserable state! With this analysis system in hand, why can't I restore my integrity and enjoy life!"
"Hahahaha"
"Xiao Qingzi, why are you laughing? It's almost night, why don't you put the books away quickly!"
"Yes."
Only then did Li Yeqing remember his responsibilities and hurriedly put the books away and put them back on the bookshelf.
This night, even the dreams were sweet.
The next morning, it started to rain lightly outside. Li Yeqing discovered that there was a leak in a corner of his room, and immediately told Eunuch Zhao.
The latter placed a deck chair under the porch, lay on it and yawned.
"If it leaks, just get a basin and plug it in. When the weather clears, climb up and fix it yourself. As for the guys in the inner prison, don't count on them. They can drag you until you're dead."
Having said this, Eunuch Zhao suddenly looked at him and smiled, showing a few teeth.
"I reported it five years ago, but those guys still said they were too busy and were busy building the palace for the emperor."
Regarding this, Li Yeqing could only express his speechlessness, and walked into the bookcase helplessly, picked up the "Yun Qi Zhan Chong Lu" on the bookshelf and continued to read carefully.
Just like a student eager to acquire knowledge.
It's a pity that I didn't have this kind of motivation when I was in school in my previous life, and in the end I only got into a junior college. Fortunately, I worked hard enough in school and was upgraded to a second major when I graduated.
[The analysis of "Yun Qi Zhan Hui Lu" is completed, Qi Watching Technique v1 (3200)]
Another prompt sounded, which to Li Yeqing at this moment was like the most beautiful music in the world.
Close your eyes and think back quietly, every bit of "Yunqi Zhanhoulu" comes to mind, as if this book was written by him, it is very familiar, and the Qi-gazing technique condensed in it also comes to mind.
Li Yeqing's thoughts moved and he looked towards the aging figure lying under the eaves behind the rain curtain outside the window.
"The white Qi represents ordinary people, with a hint of gray decay. This is a symbol of a dying person. This Qi-gazing technique is indeed magical, and it is not a fake."
"Wouldn't it be possible for me to hug my thighs from now on?"
"No, what kind of thigh am I holding on to? This system of analyzing books to obtain skills is my real thigh, and this bookstore is an endless treasure house to me!
I will never leave the bookstore, even if you kill me! "
"Unfortunately, I still felt a little reluctant to come to the bookstore at that time. This is simply too delicious!"
Forcibly suppressing the excitement in his heart, Li Yeqing put the "Clouds and Weathers" in his hand back on the bookshelf, then picked up another "Xingsheng Astrology Atlas" and continued to sit cross-legged and read.
Five days later, it was sunny on the ninth day of April in the ninth year of Daqian Qingshun.
"The food in the imperial dining room is indeed good. I see that you have only been there for a few days, and you feel that your whole person has become more mature."
Li Yeqing tasted the snacks in the food box brought by Zhou Liupei and said with a smile.
Then he picked up another piece of sweet-scented osmanthus cake and put it in his mouth. Feeling a little dry, he drank another cup of tea.
Hearing this, Zhou Liupei subconsciously touched his face and chuckled.
